title: AgentSDLC Quality Gate Schema
description: Schema defining a quality gate in the canonical gate registry

id.description: Short programmatic identifier for the gate (e.g. product, spec, contract, code, test)

name.description: Human readable name of the gate (e.g. Product Gate, Spec Gate)

implementation_status.description: Whether the gate evaluator is actively implemented or explicitly unimplemented

required_evidence.description: Description of mandatory evidence needed to pass

evaluator_role.description: Agent or automated tool authorized to evaluate this gate

blocking.description: Whether failure blocks release or transition
